title: Bible Literalists: Certainty Without Proof, Loyalty Without Scrutiny? #shorts

top_liked.author: @OpenBiolabsGuy
top_liked.text: If not for God's followers we wouldn't know anything about God and wouldn't have to be bothered with God myths.  Morality could be based on reason and empathy rather than the ultimate appeal to authority fallacy.  We could be using science and naturalism to explain the universe…

top_liked.author: @s.lynchmd539
top_liked.text: Very good bite sized summary of some of the key psychological and social influences that brought us to our current state of collective insanity!  Nice work.  Keep it up.

top_liked.author: @wilddesertgarden
top_liked.text: My mom used to tell me not to study science or history or the manuscripts of the Bible because it would hurt my faith.  This implies that she knows the truth but is trying to hide from it.  Faith is preferred because it tells a story you like, even if you know it isn't reality.
